subject: MedForge private offer — term structure, activation phasing, and usage credits
messages:
From: Alicia Montes <alicia.montes@medforge.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: MedForge Procurement <procurement@medforge.com>, Ben Cole <ben.cole@medforge.com>
Date: Sat, 27 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Private offer & RFP — term/usage questions

Hi Naomi,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the latency profile you showed looks promising for our clinical summarization use case. Procurement asked me to follow up with the RFP and a few questions that will determine whether we do a short pilot or move straight to a private offer through AWS Marketplace. RFP attached.

Quick Qs:
- Does Redwood support a staged activation (pilot -> scaled rollout) under a single private offer/PO?
- Is it possible to structure the commercial terms so usage is deducted from committed credits for the first 90 days, then metered afterwards?
- We typically prefer a 6 month minimum term for new vendor pilots; can you do 6 months or would you prefer 12 with a smaller discount?

Procurement will want SOC 2 evidence and a simple termination-for-convenience cap (30 days) for the pilot.

Attaching: MedForge_RFP.pdf

Looking to get a mutual action plan and a candidate private-offer shape by early next week.

Thanks,
Alicia
Alicia Montes
Head of Product
MedForge
[Attachment: MedForge_RFP.pdf (pdf)]

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alicia Montes <alicia.montes@medforge.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, AWS Seller Team <aws-seller-us@amazon.com>
Date: Sat, 27 Jun 2026 12:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private offer & RFP — term/usage questions

Hi Alicia — really appreciate the clear asks and the RFP. I read through it and sketched two workable tracks so procurement can pick a preference; I also created a short MAP template to show milestones and signoffs. MAP attached.

High-level options:
1) Staged activation (recommended for pilots)
   - 6-month pilot window where the first 90 days consume committed credits (to cover ramp) and the remainder is metered; pilot automatically converts to metered or annual commit unless buyer opts out with 30-day notice.
   - We can set an AWS private offer that includes a credit bucket applied first. Requires buyer PO + CFO signoff and AWS seller acceptance to enable credit logic.

2) Annual committed pathway
   - 12-month contract with a usage-based true-up and a deeper discount (we can propose ~30% vs list for first year).

Requirements from our side:
- SOC 2 Type II report (we can provide certified attestation and a short evidence pack)
- AWS seller approval for private offer and a DocuSign signature route for the buyer
- Legal review for the termination clause (we can accept 30-day trial termination for pilot with prorated refund; legal may ask for minimal language changes)

Next steps I suggest:
- If MedForge prefers the pilot shape, confirm "Option 1" and provide the PO cadence (single PO or multiple).
- Procurement to confirm SOC2 acceptance criteria and whether they need system-scoped evidence.
- I will draft Private Offer Option A (pilot) and loop Jordan to open the PO in AWS Marketplace.

Attaching: MAP_MedForge.xlsx (mutual action plan)

I'll loop Jordan and Karthik internally to get the AWS private offer ready and push for seller-side approval.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Senior Sales Lead, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: MAP_MedForge.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: MedForge Procurement <procurement@medforge.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>, Alicia Montes <alicia.montes@medforge.com>
Cc: Ben Cole <ben.cole@medforge.com>
Date: Sun, 28 Jun 2026 08:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private offer & RFP — term/usage questions

Hi Naomi,

Thanks for the clear options. Procurement reviewed and has a few requested changes for the pilot (Option 1) to move forward quickly:

1) Minimum pilot term: we need a 6-month minimum (OK to include auto-convert language at month 6).
2) Credits: agree that the first 90 days should apply against committed credits; however, credits must be invoiced as part of the PO and transparent on the AWS private offer line items.
3) Termination: 30-day termination-for-convenience is acceptable during the pilot, but we require a prorated refund clause for unused committed credits.
4) Security evidence: SOC 2 Type II + penetration test summary required before activation.

Attached are our redlines (Procurement_Redlines.docx). Also include this HubSpot reference HS-48291 when you create the private offer so our procurement system matches.

PO logistics: We will need the private offer ready to accept a single PO with an invoice milestone at T+30 days. Please also confirm whether Redwood will accept a Net-30 payment term.

Ben (CFO) is cc'd — he will sign off on any private offer that matches the redlines.

Regards,
MedForge Procurement
[Attachment: Procurement_Redlines.docx (docx)]

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
To: MedForge Procurement <procurement@medforge.com>, Alicia Montes <alicia.montes@medforge.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, AWS Seller Team <aws-seller-us@amazon.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 10:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private offer & RFP — term/usage questions

Thanks — clear and helpful. We're aligned on the pilot shape; next steps from Redwood:

1) Internal approvals: Jordan, can you open an AWS private offer with two sealed line-item options so MedForge can choose on acceptance:
   - Option A (pilot): 6-month pilot, credit bucket (invoiced on PO), credits applied first 90 days, Net-30, prorated refund for unused committed credits, SOC2 + pentest evidence required before activation.
   - Option B (commit): 12-month annual commit with a 30% first-year discount, annual invoice, Net-30.

2) Jordan: escalate to AWS seller for acceptance and ask if they can tag the private offer as "seller-approved conditional on evidence" so activation is not blocked. Link the HubSpot deal HS-48291 on the marketplace notes.

3) Karthik: legal quick-check on the procurement redlines — confirm if the proposed prorated refund language is acceptable or whether our standard limited refund clause needs a tweak. If legal signs off, we'll add legal label and route for DocuSign.

Jordan responds: "On it. I'll create PrivateOffer_OptionA.json for the pilot line items, tag the HS-48291 deal in the marketplace notes, and reach out to the AWS seller for expedited review. I'll also attach the DocuSign packet once legal confirms language."

I will provisionally accept Net-30 for this pilot (accepted by finance but requires the PO and deal id).

Link to proposed e-sign: https://www.docusign.com/sign?token=abc123medforge

Thanks everyone — aiming to have the private offer in AWS by EOD Wed so Ben can sign and procurement can issue the PO.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Senior Sales Lead, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: PrivateOffer_OptionA.json (json)]
